name: GA-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Hank Johnson running for reelection
Republican challenger has minimal reported fundraising
model.rationale: The D+27 district fundamentals, Johnson's incumbency, and a 98% market price all point to a comfortable Democratic hold, with no polls or ratings suggesting anything otherwise. The Republican challenger's lack of reported fundraising reinforces the safe rating.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending targeting Johnson would be the first sign the race is closer than priced.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Hank Johnson seeks another term in a Georgia district that leans Democratic by roughly 27 points, one of the most Democratic seats in the South. He was renominated without difficulty and enters the general election with a large structural advantage over Republican James Duffie, who has reported little in the way of fundraising or campaign infrastructure.

Prediction markets give Johnson about a 98% chance of winning, and no expert raters or polls flag the race as competitive. The expected margin is in the mid-to-high twenty points, with modest uncertainty given the absence of polling. Barring an unforeseen development, this seat is expected to remain in Democratic hands.
